20572-marie-claire.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. So she used to go and collect earthworms, and hold them up close to my face. Then I said that I wasn't in pain any more, and la mère Colas used to send us both out of doors. One day my sister threw a handful of earthworms on to my dress. arxiv-2101-08400.title: Giant dipole resonance in Sm isotopes within TDHF method
arxiv-2101-08400.creator: A. Ait Ben Mennana, M. Oulne
arxiv-2101-08400.description: Abstract In this work, we have studied the isovector giant dipole resonance (IVGDR) in even-even Sm isotopes within time-dependent Hartree-Fock (TDHF) with four Skyrme forces SLy6, SVbas, SLy5 and UNEDF1. The approach we have followed is somewhat similar to the one we did in our previous work in the region of Neodymium (Nd, Z=60) [ Physica Scripta (2020) ].

arxiv-2307-03881.title: On Delay Performance in Mega Satellite Networks with Inter-Satellite Links
arxiv-2307-03881.creator: Kosta Dakic, Chiu Chun Chan, Bassel Al Homssi, Kandeepan Sithamparanathan, Akram Al-Hourani
arxiv-2307-03881.description: Abstract Utilizing Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite networks equipped with Inter-Satellite Links (ISL) is envisioned to provide lower delay compared to traditional optical networks. However, LEO satellites have constrained energy resources as they rely on solar energy in their operations. Thus requiring special consideration when designing network topologies that do not only have low-delay link paths but also low-power consumption.

arxiv-2309-02981.title: Mid-infrared optical properties of non-magnetic-metal/CoFeB/MgO heterostructures
arxiv-2309-02981.creator: J.M. Flores-Camacho 1 , B. Rana 2 , R.E. Balderas-Navarro 1 , A. Lastras-Martínez 1 , Y. Otani 3, 4 , and J. Puebla 4
arxiv-2309-02981.description: Abstract . We report on the optical characterization of non-magnetic metal/ferromagnetic (Co 20 Fe 60 B 20 )/MgO heterostructures and interfaces by using mid infrared spectroscopic ellipsometry at room temperature. We extracted for the mid-infrared range the dielectric function of Co 20 Fe 60 B 20 , that is lacking in literature, from a multisample analysis.

arxiv-2309-15651.title: Group twirling and noise tailoring for multi-qubit controlled phase gates
arxiv-2309-15651.creator: Guoding Liu, Ziyi Xie, Zitai Xu, Xiongfeng Ma
arxiv-2309-15651.description: Abstract Group twirling is crucial in quantum information processing, particularly in randomized benchmarking and random compiling. While protocols based on Pauli twirling have been effectively crafted to transform arbitrary noise channels into Pauli channels for Clifford gates — thereby facilitating efficient benchmarking and mitigating worst-case errors — practical twirling groups for multi-qubit non-Clifford gates are lacking.

arxiv-2312-09342.title: A scheme for solving hyperbolic problems with symbolic structure Thanks: The first author was supported by the NSFC (No. 11771206). Part of the work was done while the second author was visiting Nanjing University.
arxiv-2312-09342.creator: Zhuoping Ruan, Ingo Witt
arxiv-2312-09342.description: Abstract . Hyperbolic problems can at times be solved employing symbolic arguments. This is especially true for the construction of forward (and backward) fundamental solutions. We formulate a corresponding abstract scheme and illustrate its practicality by a number of instructive examples. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 35L35; Secondary: 35L90 1.

arxiv-2508-12600.title: The Fraction of Distilled White Dwarfs with Long-Lived Habitable Zones
arxiv-2508-12600.creator: Manuel Barrientos, Mukremin Kilic, Simon Blouin, Michael R. Hayden, Sanjib Sharma, Matthew J. Green
arxiv-2508-12600.description: Abstract After carbon and oxygen, 22 Ne is the most abundant element in white dwarf interiors. As C/O white dwarfs (WDs) crystallize, they are predicted to go through a distillation process in the central layers if they have a sufficiently high 22 Ne mass fraction of ≳ 2.5 \gtrsim 2.5 %.

arxiv-2510-23254.title: Provable test-time adaptivity and distributional robustness of in-context learning
arxiv-2510-23254.creator: Tianyi Ma, Tengyao Wang, Richard J. Samworth
arxiv-2510-23254.description: Abstract We study in-context learning problems where a Transformer is pretrained on tasks drawn from a mixture distribution π = ∑ α ∈ 𝒜 λ α ​ π α \pi=\sum_{\alpha\in\mathcal{A}}\lambda_{\alpha}\pi_{\alpha} , called the pretraining prior, in which each mixture component π α \pi_{\alpha} is a distribution on tasks of a specific difficulty level indexed by α \alpha .

arxiv-2510-25160.title: Model-Document Protocol for AI Search
arxiv-2510-25160.creator: Hongjin Qian, Zheng Liu
arxiv-2510-25160.description: Abstract AI search depends on linking large language models (LLMs) with vast external knowledge sources. Yet web pages, PDF files, and other raw documents are not inherently LLM-ready: they are long, noisy, and unstructured. Conventional retrieval methods treat these documents as verbatim text and return raw passages, leaving the burden of fragment assembly and contextual reasoning to the LLM.

pmc-11339439.title: Investigating the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis as a predictor of posttraumatic stress disorder in Black Americans and the moderating effects of racial discrimination
pmc-11339439.creator: Kevin Petranu, E. Kate Webb, Carissa W. Tomas, Farah Harb, Lucas Torres, Terri A. deRoon-Cassini, Christine L. Larson
pmc-11339439.description: Altered functioning of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BNST) may play a critical role in the etiology of posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Chronic stressors such as racial discrimination and lifetime trauma are associated with an increased risk for PTSD, but it is unknown whether they influence the relationship between BNST functioning and PTSD.

pmc-11503861.title: Magnetocardiography in the Evaluation of Sudden Cardiac Death Risk: A Systematic Review
pmc-11503861.creator: Thomas Lachlan, Hejie He, Kengo Kusano, Takeshi Aiba, Donatella Brisinda, Riccardo Fenici, Faizel Osman
pmc-11503861.description: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) is responsible for 15%–20% of deaths globally/year, predominantly due to ventricular arrhythmias (VA) caused by vulnerable cardiac substrate. Identifying those at risk has proved difficult with several limitations of current methods. We evaluated the evidence for magnetocardiography (MCG) in predicting SCD events.

pmc-11656956.title: Identification of GiOMT gene family in Glycyrrhiza inflata bat and expression analysis under UV-B stresses
pmc-11656956.creator: Caijuan Li, Hao Li, Yufan Liang, Rong Miao, Ziliang Liu, Sijin Chen, Dan Zhang, Cuiling Wang, Jiling Wu, Xiangyan Zhou, Mengfei Li
pmc-11656956.description: BackgroundO-Methyltransferase (OMTs) is a class of conserved multifunctional enzymes that play important roles in plant developmental regulation, hormone signaling, secondary metabolite synthesis and abiotic stress response. The GiOMT gene family has been identified and analyzed in species such as citrus, alfalfa, Populus and grape, but has not been reported in Glycyrrhiza inflata Bat.

pmc-12085791.description: Programs for preclinical testing of targeted cancer agents in murine models of childhood cancers have been supported by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) since 2004. These programs were established to work collaboratively with industry partners to address the paucity of targeted agents for pediatric cancers compared with the large number of agents developed and approved for malignancies primarily affecting adults.

pmc-13675441.title: Next-generation digital polymerase chain reaction assay for BCR::ABL1 in chronic myeloid leukemia: comprehensive validation for standardized measurable residual disease detection
pmc-13675441.creator: Yong-Hwi Kim, Min-Sik Jang, Shin-Hyun Kim, In-Young Roh, Bong-Suk Kim, Kyung-Mi Kee, Soo-Hyun Kim, Dong-Wook Kim, Jae-Hoon Kim
pmc-13675441.description: PurposeThe sensitivity of real-time quantitative reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) for detecting measurable residual disease (MRD) in patients with chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) who have achieved a deep molecular response is limited. We validated a digital PCR (dPCR) assay (LQ Check BCR::ABL1 Major %IS Kit) for MRD quantification.
